decisions.reason: LHD loaders are central to the firm's underground mining expertise and have long sales and service cycles, so the line is likely retained despite the lack of recent website observations.
Underground dump trucks complement the loaders in a mining fleet and share engineering and service resources, which makes withdrawal unlikely.
The construction site dumper fits the firm's vehicle know-how and construction customers, though it was only mentioned briefly and faces strong competition, which raises some risk of discontinuation.
Inclined furniture lifts are a niche lifting line with dedicated pages and several models, and the construction and relocation demand in 2020 to 2022 supports keeping them.
Building material lifts serve the strong German construction market and share their platform with the furniture lifts, so the firm would likely keep them.
The truck-mounted variant is a specialized single product with a smaller market, but it builds on the shared lift platform, so it is likely kept.
